source: Minozzi S et al. J Clin Epidemiol 2020;126:37-44.
design_and_sample: Cross-sectional; 4 raters, 70 outcomes from 70 individually randomized parallel-group RCTs.
metric_denominator_unit: Overall Fleiss kappa 0.16 (95% CI 0.08-0.24); 28 minutes (SD 13.4) per outcome.
claim_supported: Sampled RoB 2 application had slight overall agreement and nontrivial time.
boundary: Not within-review calibration; not universal and not comparable to other study estimands.
access: ScienceDirect indexed abstract and PubMed PMID 32562833; full body not inspected.

source: Minozzi S et al. J Clin Epidemiol 2022;141:99-105.
design_and_sample: Sequential single-review process; 4 raters; one MS cannabis/cannabinoid Cochrane review; 80 results, 7 outcomes, 16 RCTs.
metric_denominator_unit: Overall Fleiss kappa -0.15 during calibration; 0.11 for first 5 studies after ID; 0.42 for remaining 11. Mean 168.5 versus 41 minutes/study; about 40 hours calibration/ID.
locator: Abstract p. 99; publisher indexed full text sections on RoB2 assessment, calibration/time, and main findings; pp. 99-105.
claim_supported: Tailored signalling-question instructions after calibration/discussion preceded higher observed agreement and lower time in this team.
boundary: Not randomized/controlled or a clean matched before-after; potential practice, discussion, sequence effects; no isolated causal ID effect.
access: ScienceDirect publisher-indexed full text; direct download failed; identity confirmed by exact title and DOI.

source: Bertizzolo L et al. BMJ Open 2019;9:e028382.
design_and_sample: Cross-sectional research-on-research; 2796 reviews screened, 1604 shared-review RCTs; earlier Cochrane tool.
metric_denominator_unit: Item agreement 57% (770/1348) to 81% (1193/1466); same-information interpretation in 65% (88/136) to 90% (56/62) of disagreements; incomplete/unclear sequence description 73 (83%).
locator: Abstract, Results/Table 2; Table 3 continuation, printed p. 7.
claim_supported: Same trials can receive different ratings across reviews, often through interpretation of unclear information.
boundary: Older instrument; cross-review, potentially different information; not RoB 2 or an instruction effect.
access: Publisher-indexed full-text PDF text/abstract; no local PDF.

source: Soboczenski F et al. BMC Med Inform Decis Mak 2019;19:96.
design_and_sample: Randomized within-subject task; 41 users, each assessed 4 articles; 4 RoB1 domains.
metric_denominator_unit: 82 assisted vs 82 manual articles; mean 755 vs 824 seconds/article; adjusted relative time 0.75 (95% CI 0.62-0.92).
locator: Table 3 and Results, printed pp. 6-7; methods Study design/Outcomes; PMC6505190.
claim_supported: Assisted RoB1 task was modeled 25% faster; measured time and user behavior can be evaluated directly.
boundary: Not RoB 2 or ARBITER; limited domains/task; edits/acceptance are not correctness.

source: Jardim PSJ et al. BMC Med Res Methodol 2022;22:167.
design_and_sample: Real-time mixed-methods implementation; 6 reviewers, 26 RCTs, 2 ongoing reviews; RoB1; no manual arm.
metric_denominator_unit: Acceptance RR 1.02 (95% CI 0.92-1.13), p=0.33; manual-comparator time use not estimable.
locator: Abstract; Methods Participants/ Data collection; Discussion/limitations; PMC9174024.
claim_supported: Acceptability and reviewer workflow warrant separate evaluation; similar acceptance did not provide a time estimate.
boundary: Acceptance proxy not independent accuracy; no manual comparator; small setting; RoB1.

source: Usman MS et al. Eur J Heart Fail 2024;26:373-382; Ali Salman is an author; affiliations include Dow University of Health Sciences.
claim_supported: Establishes clinical context, names a debated explanation, narrows prior-evidence limits, then states the review aim.
boundary: Editorial observation only; no claim about personal preference.
access: Wiley full text and PubMed PMID 38235936.

source: Sonbol MB et al. JAMA Oncol 2020; systematic review/NMA, coauthored by Irbaz Bin Riaz.
claim_supported: Problem-first opening leads to review rationale.
boundary: Editorial observation only; no claim about personal preference.

boundary: Does not establish personal preference; DUHS affiliation in metadata belongs to coauthor M Shahzeb Khan.
